verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins. It ships clients across platforms: a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, browser extensions, and iOS/Android apps per community reports. That implies the same vault, tokens included, is reachable on phone, tablet and computer. However, the evidence never documents automatic cross-device sync of items or TOTP secrets, and tablets are not mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic real-time sync across devices, tablet support evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of tokens syncing between mobile and desktop.

support.subject: As an everyday user, my tokens are available on my phone, tablet, and computer at the same time, kept in sync automatically

citations.quote: Proton Pass can securely generate TOTP codes for websites that you have saved login details for.
Our desktop app is available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Pity it's only available on iOS and Android as apps and as browser extensions elsewhere.
Proton Pass is my default for all 2FA.
